lines.zh: 我踩着浮萍，一步一步跳过。
lines.en: I hop across the duckweed, step by step.

lines.zh: 背上琴还挂着，走起来响。
lines.en: My lute's still on my back and thumps as I go.

lines.zh: 沼泽的路，我闭眼都认得。
lines.en: I know these swamp paths with my eyes shut.
The water's knee-deep. Just right for walking.
I step around that clutch of frog eggs.
It's getting dark; I should get home.
Mud is sticking to my toes.
Ribbit takes this path to the market.
The hem of my cloak is soaked through.

lines.zh: 前面有片荷叶，借我踩一脚。
lines.en: A lily pad ahead — I'll borrow a step.
I hum a little tune as I walk along.
The village lanterns are still lit.
Croaking comes from every direction now.
My shadow hops across the water surface.
I sit on a lily pad drying my feet.
Ribbit is counting today's takings.

lines.zh: 芦苇尖上聚了一群蚊虫。
lines.en: A cloud of midges gathers on the reed tips.
I've tuned my strings twice already.
The swamp wind carries a muddy smell.
I'm waiting for the others to start playing.
That lantern needs more oil soon.
I open my mouth, then close it.
Insects are calling from the reeds.

lines.zh: 我的屋子在第三棵树下。
lines.en: My house is under the third tree.
Not a single customer today.
I'll arrange my goods a little neater.
The water shows me my own clothes.
A frog's time passes very slowly.

lines.zh: 你走路的姿势不像本地人。
lines.en: You don't walk like anyone from here.

lines.zh: 要买东西吗？我这儿有好货。
lines.en: Buying anything? I keep good stock here.
Have you come for the ensemble too?

lines.zh: 呱呱看你像个能干活的人。
lines.en: Ribbit thinks you look like a good worker.
You smell faintly of dry hay.

lines.zh: 别踩那片荷叶，是园丁的。
lines.en: Mind that lily pad; it belongs to the gardener.
I look up at you and have to tilt far.

lines.zh: 你手上有紫水晶？给我看看。
lines.en: Amethyst in your hand? Let me see it.
You're far gentler than a piranha.

lines.zh: 村子欢迎客人，也欢迎钱。
lines.en: The village welcomes guests, and their coins.
I croak once, and that's my greeting.

lines.zh: 你想加入合奏？先找把琴。
lines.en: Want to join the band? Find a lute first.

lines.zh: 我认得你，你上次也来过。
lines.en: I know you; you came by last time.

lines.zh: 我们这儿人少，但很热闹。
lines.en: We're few here, but it gets lively.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我才看清你的脸。
lines.en: You crouch, and only then do I see your face.
The water at your feet is warmer than outside.
My health is fifteen points, no more.
There's a tear in my cloak now.
I toppled into the muddy water.
That landed harder than I expected.
My lute fell to the ground.
Where's the wizard? I need a remedy.
I crouch down and cover my head.
Not the face — I still have customers.
I hop into the reeds and hide.

lines.zh: 整个村子都听见我呱了。
lines.en: The whole village heard that croak.
That bug in your hand is still moving.
A lute string? I happen to need one.
I don't eat bread, but thank you.

lines.zh: 藤蔓上的虫子飞过来了。
lines.en: A bug just flew off the vines.
Amethyst? That's something I'd love.
I hopped forward one small step.
Set it on the ground; then I'll come.
This smells a lot like a moth.
I stick out my tongue, then pull it back.
We could talk about the price.
Sorry — I hopped a bit too eagerly.
I bumped you and my cloak went crooked.

lines.zh: 你的靴筒高过我整个身子。
lines.en: Your boot shaft stands higher than my whole body.
I hop back twice and steady myself.

lines.zh: 湿泥从你鞋上蹭到我腿。
lines.en: Wet mud rubbed from your shoe onto me.

lines.zh: 我们差点一起摔进水里。
lines.en: We nearly tumbled into the water together.
I nearly dropped the goods in my hands.
Don't crowd me; this plank bridge is narrow.
I croak once, which counts as an apology.
My webbed foot is pinned under your boot.
We sing back and forth beside the reeds.
Its voice is brighter than mine.
Two frogs and one lute. That's plenty.
We nod together, keeping the same beat.
It gave up the lily pad for me.

lines.zh: 我们打算在浅水里筑巢。
lines.en: We plan to build a nest in the shallows.
It croaks once, and I take the next line.

lines.zh: 我们的脚在水里碰了一下。
lines.en: Our feet touched under the water.

lines.zh: 这一带没有别的蛙唱得这么好。
lines.en: No other frog here sings half so well.
When night falls we'll head home together.

lines.zh: 我捡起一枚掉落的硬币。
lines.en: I pick up a coin someone dropped.
This reed would make a fine lute neck.
I tuck the goods into my cloak pocket.
Someone dropped a shard of amethyst.
A lily pad — good for wrapping things.
I found a dead bug on the path.
This copper coin is caked with mud.
Too much to carry; my arms are full.
I drop it into my little basket.
The merchant would buy this from me.
There's a bug over there, a big one.
I hear someone knocking on the plank bridge.
The gardener's patch needs watering now.
A guest is standing at the village gate.
What's that sound? Not a frog.

lines.zh: 我朝摊子那边看了一眼。
lines.en: I glance over toward my little stall.
The wizard hasn't come out today.
Something's stirring on the water.
Where should this amethyst go?
I've decided to go over and ask.
I keep my eyes on it while hopping.
It's leaving; I'll pick up the pace.
I can be there in three hops.
It's heading toward the village gate.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，藏在芦苇后。
lines.en: I crouch low behind the reeds.
I count its steps as it walks off.
This is just close enough to talk.
I've filed it away in my mind.
It halted, so I pulled my legs in.

lines.zh: 那条路通向我家的方向。
lines.en: That path runs toward my own house.
I slap with one webbed foot.
This punch is a pitiful little thing.
I hop up and bump your knee.

lines.zh: 我的琴都甩到背后去了。
lines.en: My lute has swung around behind me.

lines.zh: 别打摊子，那是我吃饭的。
lines.en: Not the stall — that's how I make a living.

lines.zh: 我推了一下，自己先退了。
lines.en: I push once and end up backing away.
The wizard will deal with you.

lines.zh: 我拿脑门撞了你的小腿。
lines.en: I butted my forehead into your shin.

lines.zh: 这一下大概只够吓唬虫。
lines.en: That's barely enough to scare a bug.

lines.zh: 打完我赶紧理了理斗篷。
lines.en: After that I hurriedly fixed my cloak.

lines.zh: 我在沼泽村的浅水里睁眼。
lines.en: I open my eyes in the swamp village shallows.
Croaking and lantern light surround me.

lines.zh: 我的第一把琴是别人给的。
lines.en: My first lute was a gift from someone.
I picked a house close to the water.
The village has one more mouth today.
I set the amethyst by my door.

lines.zh: 有人教我怎么辨认药材。
lines.en: Someone showed me how to sort herbs.

lines.zh: 我披上斗篷，走进芦苇里。
lines.en: I put on my cloak and stepped into reeds.
I haven't settled on a trade yet.

lines.zh: 泥水暖着，我打了个哈欠。
lines.en: The mud is warm; I yawn once.

lines.zh: 沼泽也会着火，我的皮肤太干。
lines.en: Swamps burn too, and my skin dries fast.
I fell right off the plank bridge.
The water's too deep; I can't swim.
A blast, and my stall is gone.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉在我的斗篷上。
lines.en: An arrow pinned itself to my cloak.

lines.zh: 紫光缠住我，我的腿发麻。
lines.en: Violet light wraps me and my legs go numb.
I can't even catch a flying bug now.

lines.zh: 雷落在芦苇上，我趴低了。
lines.en: Lightning struck the reeds; I flattened down.

lines.zh: 这里没有水，也没有蛙鸣。
lines.en: No water here, and no croaking either.
